title: Neyman Orthogonal Activation Steering
abstract: arXiv:2610.33217v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Activation steering is a popular approach for shifting LLM output toward a desired behavior, and increasingly for generating realistic synthetic data. The standard recipe estimates a steering direction by contrasting LLM activations on prompts with and without a target concept, such as truthfulness. In this paper, we separate the estimand (the steering direction these methods target) from the estimator used to recover it, two notions the literature often conflates. We frame nearly all existing methods as plug-in estimators of the average gradient of an outcome regression, with the binary contrastive label fixed as the outcome. Using this framing, we can immediately incorporate flexible modeling approaches and extend existing methods to allow for continuous outcomes such as log-probabilities or oracle ratings. translated_abstract: 激活引导是一种流行的方法，用于将大语言模型的输出转向期望的行为，并且越来越多地被用于生成逼真的合成数据。标准做法是通过对比模型在包含与不包含目标概念（如真实性）的提示上的激活来估计引导方向。在本文中，我们将估计对象（这些方法所针对的引导方向）与用于恢复它的估计器分离开来——这两个概念在文献中常常被混淆。我们将几乎所有现有方法框架化为结果回归平均梯度的代入式估计器，其中二元的对比标签被固定为结果。利用这一框架，我们可以立即引入灵活的建模方法，并将现有方法扩展到允许连续型结果，例如对数概率或评分模型给出的打分。然而，能很好地拟合结果的灵活机器学习模型未必能很好地估计梯度，这促使我们设计针对……的估计器（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文将激活引导方法中的“估计对象”与“估计器”区分开来，把现有方法统一框架化为结果回归平均梯度的代入式估计器，并借助 Neyman 正交性构造对模型误差更稳健的估计器，同时将方法扩展到对数概率等连续型结果。
en_tdlr: This paper disentangles the estimand from the estimator in activation steering, unifies existing methods as plug-in estimators of the average gradient of an outcome regression, and leverages Neyman orthogonality to build more robust estimators that extend to continuous outcomes such as log-probabilities.
